headline: June 2026, hotel room occupancy rate of star hotels in Jakarta reaches 55.47 percent
summary: Statistics Indonesia recorded a room occupancy rate of 55.47% for Jakarta's star hotels in June 2026, up 1.62 points. The figure reflects tourism and business travel demand in the capital.
why: Hotel occupancy is a timely gauge of domestic travel and business activity, and it feeds into hospitality sector earnings. Statistics Indonesia (BPS) publishes official economic statistics for the country.
